name: Human control of consequential agent action
statement: Agents can generate high-quality actions but external consequences require deterministic scoped authority.
current_solution: QP GRANT + proof-level gate + credential broker + H-task fallback

name: Behavioral proof of working software
statement: Code/test presence can still produce false-done; need validators tied to user-visible consequences.
current_solution: Active/attested evidence classes + deterministic validators; self-reported live events remain claims

name: Correct checkpoint granularity
statement: Too coarse hides failures; too fine creates overhead.
current_solution: Each checkpoint proves one externally observable transition and states exactly what it implies.

name: Autonomous vs augmented vs human task frontier
statement: Maximum autonomy is not the objective; expected verified progress per human-minute is.
current_solution: M/H/A task class + confidence/risk + run metrics

name: Cross-project component reuse
statement: Cmail, security, QP, demand and commerce primitives should compound rather than fork.
current_solution: Shared component registry and explicit project dependency matrix

name: Learning from alternative successful paths
statement: Different agents can reach the same gate through different paths; the trajectories are training data.

name: Correctly identify the scarce external asset
statement: Software can look differentiated while the underlying economic resource is public or bypassable.
current_solution: Software substitution test + scarce asset declaration + resource-controller/right/capture analysis

name: Shortest path to first real moat event
statement: Feature-complete roadmaps delay the first observation that could validate or kill the business thesis.
current_solution: UNDERENGINEER chooses one moat event, minimum prerequisites, safety/verification, explicit NOT_NOW and observation pause.
experiments: human minutes to first asset unit
features built before first live outcome

name: Underlying resource owner can bypass the interface
statement: Owning an adapter is weak if the actual resource controller can expose the same capability directly to a dominant agent platform.
current_solution: Track controller, our_right, platform_capture and independent customer/outcome ownership per scarce asset.
